verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs name a Batch Processing API for high-volume processing. They also describe asynchronous screening built for high-volume scenarios, with webhook notification when workflows complete. Together these show a first-party bulk capability for customer screening, but the evidence is a single brief mention with no detail on how batches work. missing for 10: documentation of Batch Processing API mechanics (payload format, limits, status tracking), bulk actions beyond screening (e.g., bulk case/alert remediation or decisions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
